title: Auto-purge stale session worktrees
description: Polaris creates a git worktree under %TEMP%\polaris-wt\ for every chat session but never cleans them up. Over time these accumulate (60+ directories observed). Add a startup sweep (and optionally a periodic timer) that removes worktrees older than 7 days: (1) list all registered worktrees via git worktree list --porcelain, (2) skip the main worktree and any branch-named worktrees (task/* or wip/*), (3) for detached-HEAD worktrees whose directory mtime is older than the threshold, run git worktree remove --force, (4) log each removal to the existing Polaris health/log channel. Threshold should be a constant (DEFAULT_WORKTREE_TTL_DAYS = 7) near the top of server.js. The sweep must never remove a worktree whose session is still open (check against active sessionStore entries by matching the worktree path).
